audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the five universal gift-taste lists and every love, like, dislike, hate and neutral response for Robin, Demetrius, Maru, Sebastian, Linus, Pierre and Caroline. All 35 dialogue fields were translated in character; all alternating item-ID/category fields, empty delimiters, placeholders and dialogue markers were preserved exactly. The five universal records contain no player-facing prose and are explicitly justified.
